title: Call of Duty: World at War

custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on Call of Duty: World at War as a historical World War II digital filing.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art; collection photography does not apply.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account and Steam’s ongoing support for the title. Multiplayer components may depend on third-party or Activision services.
preservation.concerns: Older online multiplayer titles face elevated server and matchmaking risk. Account-bound licensing and the absence of a retained offline installer remain the principal preservation concerns.
preservation.knownRevisions: Steam release dated November 18, 2008. This accession records the licensed digital edition in custody.
preservation.availability: Playable from the archive Steam library for as long as that license and storefront path remain intact.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.

stewardshipHistory.note: Steam library artwork filed under the Library accession path.
